arabic text: HAI TERI WAFAON KI AJAB GHAZI KAHANI
english translation text: TALES OF YOUR LOYALTY OH ABBAS ARE INDESCRIBABLE

arabic text: BACHPAN PEH SAKINA KAY FIDA KAR DI JAWANI
english translation text: YOU SACRIFICED YOUR YOUTH FOR THE SAKINA’S CHILDHOOD

arabic text: TU FATIMA ZAHRA KI, DUAON KA SILA HAI\nABBAS TERA NAAM HI, ZAINAB KI RIDA HAI\nAB TAK TERA MAMNOON HAI, ISLAM KA BANI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE RESULT OF BIBI ZAHRA’S DUA\nJUST YOUR NAME ABBAS, IS THE HIJAB FOR ZAINAB\nTHE RELIGION OF ISLAM IS STILL INDEBTED TO YOUR SACRIFICE

arabic text: HAI TERI WAFAON KI AJAB GHAZI KAHANI
english translation text: TALES OF YOUR LOYALTY OH ABBAS ARE INDESCRIBABLE

arabic text: ZAHRA KI LAHAD KAAMPI, HAIDER NAY NAJAF CHHORA\nRO RO KAY YEH SHAH BOLAY, MERI KAMAR KO BHI TORA\nJAB KHOON MAIN TAR DEKHI, GHAZI KI PAYSHANI
english translation text: THE GRAVE OF BIBI ZAHRA SHUDDERED AND IMAM ALI LEFT NAJAF\nIMAM HUSSAIN CRIED OUT THAT MY BACKBONE HAS BEEN BROKEN\nWHEN HE SAW ABBAS’ HEAD DROWNED IN BLOOD

arabic text: HAI TERI WAFAON KI AJAB GHAZI KAHANI
english translation text: TALES OF YOUR LOYALTY OH ABBAS, ARE INDESCRIBABLE

arabic text: RONAY KAY LIYE MOLA, KYA BAAT YEH KAM HAI\nKITNA TUJHE MASOOMO KI, HAYE PYAAS KA GHAM HAY\nDARIYA PEH KIYA KABZA, PIYA PHIR BHI NA PAANI
english translation text: IS THIS REASON NOT ENOUGH TO CRY FOR, OH MOLA ABBAS?\nTHAT YOUR GRIEF IS FOR THE THIRST OF MANY INNOCENT ONES\nYOU TOOK CONTROL OF THE RIVER, YET YOU STILL DID NOT DRINK

arabic text: HAI TERI WAFAON KI AJAB GHAZI KAHANI
english translation text: TALES OF YOUR LOYALTY OH ABBAS, ARE INDESCRIBABLE

arabic text: AB KAUN BACHAYEGA, MERAY SAR KI RIDA GHAZI\nSAR PEET KAY KEHTI THI, YEH ZAHRA-E-SAANI\nKIS TARHA SEH AB JAONGI, MAY SHAAM BATA GHAZI
english translation text: NOW WHO WILL SAVE MY VEIL OH ABBAS?\nHOW WILL I GO TO SHAAM, YOU TELL ME OH ABBAS?\nZAINAB WAS SAYING THESE WORDS AS SHE BEAT HER HEAD
